title: 第21章 我怀孕了第22章 缝上你的嘴
slug: 娇娇挺孕肚死遁清冷师尊黑化了
content_zh:
宁楚慌忙起身，后退两步，跟鹤隐舟拉开距离，讪讪一笑，“我，我就是想来看看他的伤势，嘿嘿。”
“哦。”她了然地点点头，旋即又反应过来，“不对啊，我没跟你说过小师叔住这里啊？”
宁楚心中一惊，下意识摸了摸鼻尖，“我从其他弟子口中知道的。”
“哎呀这不重要。”她拔高声音，忙不迭转移话题，指着鹤隐舟对宁雄霸道：“宗主，你快看看他这是怎么了？好像修为尽失了。”
“啥？！”宁雄霸熊眼圆瞪，大步上前，神识一弹，果然在鹤隐舟身上没感觉到半点灵气。
他登时慌了，手忙脚乱就要去捉鹤隐舟的手，被他抬手挡住。
鹤隐舟抬眸，淡淡地看着宁雄霸，“师兄，我如今变成这样，全都要归功于你身边这位修士。”
此言一出，宁雄霸父女两人齐刷刷看向宁楚，眼神晦涩难明。
宁楚浑身僵硬，不可置信地后退一步，总觉得自己脖子凉凉的。
她艰涩地咽了口唾沫，说出来的话却没什么气势，“我，我都说了我不是故意的。”
“而且，而且，我这不是来看望你了吗？”
“灵气爆炸这种事我也没想到，这怎么能怪我呢？”
宁雄霸才不听她说什么，直接提着她的后衣领将人提起来，“小师弟，你想如何处置她？”
他虽然是个大块头，但却是个妥妥的师弟脑，只要师弟怎么说，他就怎么做。
宁楚双脚离地，不断扑腾着，“宗主，你别冲动，有话好好说。”
宝儿见状，忙抱住宁雄霸另一只胳膊，撒娇道：“爹，楚楚说得对，咱们有话好好说。”
“再说了，您不是想收楚楚为徒吗？”
闻言，宁雄霸也冷静下来，想到宁楚那惊人的天赋，眼珠转了半圈，对鹤隐舟说：“小师弟啊，你看看能不能给她留条命？”
“师兄我实在是稀罕她，想她给我当徒弟。”
鹤隐舟神色未变，目光扫过宁家两父女，落在宁楚身上，几不可察勾唇，“既然师兄开口，那便让她留在我身边，照顾我到修为恢复吧。”

“这个好这个好。”一听他这么说，宁雄霸瞬间把宁楚往地上一放，哈哈大笑，“我看行。”
“楚楚，在我小师弟修为恢复之前，你就先住无妄峰吧。”
“不过千万记住，他修为尽失一事不可告诉任何人。”
宁楚下意识点点头，又反应过来，“那他的修为什么时候才能恢复啊？”
“要是一辈子不恢复，难不成还要我照顾他一辈子？”
她是打算顺水推舟先留在鹤隐舟身边，看看能不能降低他的黑化值，可也不能没有一个期限啊。
“这……”宁雄霸眉心拧成一个川字，实不相瞒，他也不知道鹤隐舟的修为何时能恢复。
小师弟是天剑宗唯一修炼无情道功法的修士，其中玄机奥妙，恐怕只有他自己知道。
他看向鹤隐舟，鹤隐舟垂着眉眼，以拳抵唇闷咳一声，“三年。”
“三年？那也太久了吧？”宁楚下意识抚上自己的小腹，一张小脸皱成苦瓜。
她的崽最多还有不到七个月就该出生，她不能让崽出生了还住在这里。
“楚楚，可是有什么不妥？”宝儿歪着头看她，一双大眼眨巴眨巴。
宁雄霸：“楚楚，你看这样如何？我明日便收你为徒，你以我徒弟的身份在这里照顾隐舟，同时我会教你修炼，助你成功结丹。”
“不可。”
“不要！”
content_en:
Ning Chu stood up in a hurry, took two steps back, distanced himself from He Yinzhou, and smiled, "I, I just wanted to see his injury, hehe."
"Oh." She nodded in understanding, and immediately realized, "No, I didn't tell you that my junior uncle lives here?"
Ning Chu was shocked and subconsciously touched the tip of his nose, "I know this from other disciples."
"Oh, it's not important." She raised her voice and hurriedly changed the subject. She pointed at He Yinzhou and said domineeringly to Ning Xiong: "Sect Master, look at what's wrong with him? It seems that he has lost all his cultivation."
"What?!" Ning Xiongba's eyes widened and he strode forward. With a flick of his consciousness, he found that he didn't feel any spiritual energy in He Yinzhou's body.
He immediately panicked and was about to grab He Yinzhou's hand, but he raised his hand to block it.
He Yinzhou raised his eyes and looked at Ning Xiongba calmly, "Senior brother, I am like this now, all thanks to the monk beside you."
As soon as these words came out, Ning Xiongba and his daughter both looked at Ning Chu, their eyes unclear.
Ning Chu's whole body stiffened and he took a step back in disbelief. He felt his neck was cold.
She swallowed hard, but her words had no momentum, "I, I told you I didn't mean it."
"And, besides, didn't I come to visit you?"
"I didn't expect such a spiritual energy explosion. How can you blame me?"
Ning Xiongba didn't listen to what she said and directly lifted her up by her collar, "Junior brother, what do you want to do with her?"
Although he is a big guy, he is a proper junior brother. As long as his junior brother says, he will do whatever he says.
Ning Chu lifted his feet off the ground and kept fluttering, "Sect Master, don't be impulsive. If you have anything to say, say it properly."
Seeing this, Bao'er quickly hugged Ning Xiongba's other arm and said coquettishly: "Dad, Chu Chu is right, we have something to talk about."
"Besides, don't you want to accept Chu Chu as your disciple?"
Hearing this, Ning Xiongba also calmed down. Thinking of Ning Chu's amazing talent, he rolled his eyes half a circle and said to He Yinzhou: "Junior brother, see if you can save her life?"
"Senior brother, I really miss her and want her to be my apprentice."
He Yinzhou's expression did not change, his eyes swept over the two fathers and daughters of the Ning family, and landed on Ning Chu. His lips curled up almost imperceptibly, "Since senior brother has spoken, let her stay by my side and take care of me until my cultivation level recovers."
"This is good, this is good." Upon hearing what he said, Ning Xiongba immediately put Ning Chu on the ground and laughed, "I think it will work."
"Chu Chu, before my junior brother's cultivation level recovers, you should stay at Wuwang Peak first."
"But remember, don't tell anyone that he has lost all his cultivation."
Ning Chu nodded subconsciously and then reacted, "Then when will his cultivation be restored?"
"If he doesn't recover for the rest of his life, will he still need me to take care of him for the rest of his life?"
She planned to go with the flow and stay with He Yinzhou first to see if she could reduce his blackening value, but she couldn't do it without a deadline.
"This..." Ning Xiongba twisted his eyebrows into the character "Sichuan", telling the truth that he didn't know when He Yinzhou's cultivation would be restored.
The junior brother is the only monk in the Tianjian Sect who practices the ruthless Dao technique. I am afraid that only he himself knows the secrets of it.
He looked at He Yinzhou, who lowered his eyebrows, put his fist to his lips and coughed, "Three years."
"Three years? That's too long, right?" Ning Chu subconsciously touched his belly, his face wrinkled into a bitter melon.
Her cub is due to be born in less than seven months at most, and she cannot let the cub live here after it is born.
"Chuchu, what's wrong?" Bao'er tilted his head and looked at her, blinking with his big eyes.
Ning Xiongba: "Chu Chu, what do you think of this? I will accept you as my disciple tomorrow. You will take care of Yin Zhou here as my disciple. At the same time, I will teach you how to practice and help you successfully form the elixir."
"No."
"No!”
